levels.label: Mk 1 · Depot
levels.description: The compact depot: ramps, low cover, corridors, and three patrolling guards.

levels.label: Mk 2 · Expanded depot
levels.description: A larger course with multiple elevations, longer patrols, credentials, and an extraction uplink.

levels.label: Mk 3 · Vent works
levels.description: Two guard-patrolled floors, thick service walls and five crawl routes: straight ducts, elbows, diagonal bends and a 45 degree riser. Find the service key, then extract upstairs.

levels.label: Mk 4 · Cargo works
levels.description: Move cargo with Use to uncover salvage and a vent. Stack a crate to climb the low salvage wall. Full-height partitions meet a solid ceiling: use the vents to reach the loading relay, then extract. The bench behind spawn has a pistol, rifle, shotgun and ammo; open the bag or press I to equip.

levels.label: Mk 5 · Catwalk complex
levels.description: Infiltrate two guarded double-height bays around central pits. Collect weapons and ammo, crawl through lower and upper service vents, override west security, download the catwalk uplink, then authorize extraction in the east bay and escape upstairs.

levels.label: Mk 6 · Swimming skills [PROTO]
levels.description: [PROTO] Compare swimming grades 0–3 at the four starting-deck stations: faster strokes, longer breath and quieter splashes. Time the submerged 9 m ring lane. NPCs compare grades 0 and 3; Demo cycles all four. Jump rises, Crouch dives. Comparison resets on replay; campaign training remains open.

levels.label: Human skills · Practical grades [PROTO]
levels.description: Compare Neophyte, Technite, Acolyte and Paragon in seven natural skills: weapon handling, close combat, athletics, stealth, combined Engineering, Medicine and Persuasion. Cycle individual skills or set all at the spawn consoles. Practice on real targets and ledges, repair service gates, treat injured crew and negotiate evidence-based agreements. Parts and kits are finite; moving or damage interrupts work. Replay resets comparisons. Swimming remains in Mk 6.

levels.label: Mk 7 · Hazard works
levels.description: Keep the classic fire-cover, burn/quench and live-water breaker trial, then explore 14 more hazards: steam, flammable gas and ventilation, toxic coolant, a cargo-jammable press, hot and cold surfaces, ignitable oil, rising electrified water, conductive cargo, a falling load, a laser alarm, decompression and cumulative radiation. Counter each source with valves, breakers, cargo, water, shielding or a safer route.

levels.label: Weapon gym · Arsenal
levels.description: Pick up weapons and ammunition with Use. Fire, reload and reset the practice targets. Includes the full experimental arsenal.

levels.label: Lab · Unarmed combat
levels.description: Experimental boxing, stamina, blocks, parries and guard breaks. Watch the sparring or take control.

levels.label: Lab · Evidence & distraction
levels.description: Throw a noise distraction and watch guards investigate uncertain evidence.

levels.label: Lab · Nonlethal takedown
levels.description: Approach from behind, restrain a guard and observe recovery. Experimental mechanics remain separate from the main gyms.

levels.label: Lab · Guard coordination
levels.description: Guards share delayed and uncertain reports over a radio network.

levels.label: Lab · Dialogue & story
levels.description: Talk to friendly crew, exchange a fuse for an engineering pass, unlock the passage and claim supplies. This test chain uses the TestStory scope and resets on reload. Story tools expose conditions, variables, traces and Reset Story.

levels.label: Hydroponics · The Understory
levels.description: PROTO first level. Escape a palisaded settlement with victims and sealed hypersleep sacks. Learn movement, crouching and covered stealth, find an upper-level raid recorder by the pistol cache, and decide whether to free a captured soldier. A journal keeps recovered notes and conversation history. Beyond: cavernous growing halls, reservoirs, timber bridges and hidden passages.

levels.label: NEW · Silent Relay [PROTO]
levels.description: A candidate sector beyond the Understory. Restore a crew neural relay, borrow real camera sight, release a gate with an implant impulse, and lure a sentinel with a service chime. Neural strain limits remote use and handshakes reveal your body's position. A shielded chamber blocks the link: use its local latch. A crouch-only service duct offers a route without powers. Recover the crew transit record, then leave north. All new lore and geometry are PROTO.

levels.label: NEW · The Ration Engine [PROTO]
levels.description: Naya's farm runs on Anahita's old power grid. Divert the west grow lights to power a real crew lift, or find a spare feeder link in the east workshop and repair the reserve without darkening the crops. A longer west service ramp needs no power. Restore the grow lights from the crew gallery, recover the service dispatch, then depart north. Machinery uses the ordinary Use button on mobile and desktop. All new geometry and story text are PROTO.

levels.label: NEW · Recommissioning [PROTO]
levels.description: Recover a compatible core and procedures, then fit one active configuration: Impulse Leap, Dive Jet, Induction Grip, Optical Veil, Echo Lattice, Tension Spool or Resonance Lure after discovering their procedures. Earn Paced Recovery through practice, operate the physical cargo lock, then cross Mir’s optical calibration gap quietly. Each challenge has an unaugmented route. PROTO gains persist only this session. Recover the Echo survey record to unlock Resonance Lure: place a finite audible source and test its effect on a real investigating walker in the northwest acoustic station.

levels.label: NEW · Echo Annex [PROTO]
levels.description: Rosh’s acoustic annex is dark. Recover the Echo Lattice procedure and fit its core, then pulse to read physical surfaces up to 12 m. Returns last seven seconds, cost stamina and emit a real audible ping. Navigate alternating baffles to recover the survey record. The lit west maintenance passage reaches a real work-light feeder without any implant. Gains are shared with Recommissioning only for this session.

levels.label: NEW · Tension Loft [PROTO]
levels.description: Recover Mir’s transit rigging procedure and fit Tension Spool. Aim at the marked overhead anchor, then tap Augment to pull the real body onto a high gallery. Tap again to release; normal falling resumes. Coupling costs 20 stamina plus 6/s, lasts up to four seconds and respects physical obstruction. The west service ramp reaches the same rigging archive without an implant. Gains share this session with Recommissioning and Echo Annex.

levels.label: Streaming gym · Zone handoffs
levels.description: [PROTO] Compare all-resident, synchronous, threaded-load and budgeted activation across a 240 m course: two large zones plus a sparse connector, three equal zones, or six smaller zones. Code-built geometry is merged by zone. Threaded resource loading is unavailable in the current single-thread Web build; its report separates manifest load time from main-thread geometry activation.

levels.label: NEW · Vault & mantle gym
levels.description: Two lit training lanes: vault teal low rails, mantle amber ledges, and test the red blocked-clearance station. Watch both trainees complete real traversal, or take player control while the NPC continues. Move toward a lit edge and press Jump / Space.
